_comment: Units the government has replaced, abolished or reorganised away.
scripts/mark_superseded_units.py is the only writer of these four fields and
the curated file is never hand-edited. Nothing here is deleted: a superseded
node keeps its id, name, description, evidence and place in the tree, and the
viewer simply does not draw it unless the reader asks for replaced units.
Every row quotes the words an official page uses to say so, and that page is
re-fetched and the quote re-checked on every run — a supersession is a positive
claim and needs a source that states it. Drop a row and the next run withdraws
the claim. CURATION.md §10 carries the evidence and the correction it took.

superseded.quote: The Department of Veterans Affairs comprises 5 Veterans Integrated Service Networks or VISNs
superseded.note: One of the eighteen networks the VA consolidated under RISE. No successor is recorded for it individually because the territories were redrawn rather than renumbered: the five new networks partition the states afresh, so no old network maps onto one new one. The date is the day VA published the five-network leadership roster at digital.va.gov/rise/leadership/; VA has published no single effective date for the change, and this one is the earliest dated official artefact showing the new structure staffed.
